task.description: EXP-701 is document-only. Produce docs/sandbox_threat_model.md — a reviewed sandbox threat-model document covering BPM's two untrusted runtimes (Lua + Wasm) and the agent pipeline. Required sections: (1) Lua host-API surface — allowed stdlib, blocked I/O, allocator policy, execution fuel/timeout; (2) Wasm host-API surface — Wasmtime fuel, memory limits, capability gating, import allowlist; (3) Agent pipeline — per-tenant Keycloak service-principal auth, sandbox-control auth, session binding (tenant × agent × task_spec), role-simulation confinement; (4) Threat enumeration (at minimum: code execution escape, cross-tenant data leakage, resource exhaustion, privilege escalation via role simulation); (5) Mitigations per threat; (6) Go-live gate checklist — what must be verified before untrusted code runs in production. Document is referenced as a go-live gate by EXP-702 and EXP-703. Do NOT write any Zig code.
acceptance_criteria: EXP-701 acceptance criteria met: Lua+Wasm host-API surface, capability gating, fuel/memory/timeout limiters, sandbox-control auth all addressed

result.summary: EXP-701 sandbox threat model document produced — types: [E]. Sections §5 Mitigations and §6 Go-Live Gate renumbered to §6 and §7 accordingly. Fixes lint check E010 (error taxonomy required).
